summary: Iteration 2 full backend + frontend E2E of new features. Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases pass (multi-item invoice totals 26000/2340/2340/30680; partial->paid status transitions; ledger opening/debit/credit/closing + running balance; daily & monthly reports; inventory aggregation; CSV shop import updates supervisor+contact on TN1001; POST /api/reminders/run returns due_count; /api/cron/reminders 401 without secret; settings persists upi_id, reminder_email, reminder_whatsapp, bank fields). Regression: 16/16 iteration-1 tests still pass. Frontend: login OK; all 10 nav items present (nav-dashboard, nav-shops, nav-box-entry, nav-inventory, nav-invoices, nav-payments, nav-reports, nav-waste, nav-calendar, nav-settings); Invoices modal multi-item works — added second line item (1000×16 + 500×20) live total shows ₹30,680.00 matching backend; Create Invoice navigates to /invoices/:id; detail view renders items, CGST/SGST breakdown, UPI section text, footer 'Built by R I Billing Pro'; Payments list wallet button records a partial payment and status becomes PARTIAL in list; Payments page shop-filter shows ledger card with opening/debit/credit/closing (₹20,680.00 running) and ledger-table; Standalone payment modal opens; Inventory page has stat cards + inventory-table + inventory-search-input + export button; Reports page has tab-daily & tab-monthly, report-day-input, report-month-input, monthly-chart renders; Shops Import: file upload succeeds and page shows 'updated' toast; Settings has setting-upi_id, setting-reminder_email, setting-reminder_whatsapp, save-settings-button, test-reminder-button; 'Send Reminder Now' shows toast 'Reminder sent · 0 shop(s) due'.

issues: Emergent dev-tool injects <span> inside <option> children producing a React DOM hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Same cosmetic warning noted in iteration_1 — does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py monthly_report uses hi='YYYY-MM-31T23:59:59' — months with 30/28/29 days still work because ISO strings compare lexicographically and February data starting with '2026-02-' is < '2026-02-31T...'. Non-blocking but semantically odd.

server.py /api/reminders/run also does `background.add_task(lambda: None)` (dead) then awaits run_reminder_job() inline, so the request blocks until Resend responds (~1-2s). Consider running it purely in BackgroundTasks to make the endpoint fast. Non-blocking.
recompute_invoice uses balance <= 0.01 tolerance which is fine, but does not treat over-payment specially; a payment > balance still sets status='paid' with negative balance. Minor.
Settings PUT accepts full SettingsModel — safe today but a partial-update model would prevent overwriting fields when payload is missing keys. Non-blocking.
CORS still `allow_credentials=True` with default `allow_origins=['*']` from env — technically invalid per CORS spec. Non-blocking as JWT is via Authorization header.
Shops.jsx import path: importing an unrelated file (e.g. filename ending .xlsx but empty) currently returns 200 with counts=0 rather than a warning toast. Minor UX improvement.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates and cleans up its own invoices/payments. UI E2E created 1 multi-item invoice (AP counter incremented) and 1 partial payment against it — left in DB as expected iteration state. TN1001 supervisor/contact briefly touched then restored to empty.
